issue.title: bug: Subagent child slots are never released: idle children permanently consume the max_children budget, and no tool can close them

steps: Use the native child-agent tools to delegate eight separate tiny tasks, one at a time. For task i (1 through 8), ask a new child named child-i to reply with its number, wait for it to finish, and consume its result. After all eight are finished, delegate one more tiny task to a new child named child-9. Report actual tool outcomes.
expected: Completed children can release the active-child budget so a later task can be delegated.
defect: The ninth spawn is refused because idle completed children permanently occupy all eight slots.
Root cause: The reported child registry counts retained session children toward max_children and exposes no release/close operation. Completion changes activity status but not registry occupancy. Source confirmation and later runtime validation must distinguish an intentional retained-session limit from an active-child limit.
